lens_perspectives.observation: generate_clothing_shells returns ClothingError, and equipment_export 141–151 maps it through Error::msg; PNG EncodingError flows through tiny-skia Pixmap and is formatted at studio 112–113. Nested-cause reachability and error consumers remain bounded.
ClothingError and png::EncodingError are actual native/bespoke error owners before adapters; precise feature exposure and application policy remain open.
Error::msg accepts Display+Debug+Send+Sync rather than requiring StdError; its standard error alternative has a stricter trait contract. Feature cfg and all other constructors remain unread.
Two distinct conversions transform the carried diagnostic state: Error::msg suppresses delegated source; studio to_string discards the owned PNG error. No runtime operation was performed.
An error payload, its downcast identity, display and nested source have independent properties; retaining a direct payload is not evidence of a retained nested cause.
Keep the project and native error ownership boundaries distinct; a prospective future repair must resolve dependency and native port without inferring that third-party source should change.
No independent duplicate source-of-truth defect established in these bounded constructor and adapter windows.

EncodingError distinguishes IoError, Format, Parameter and LimitsExceeded, while IconError Png(String) preserves only a broad category and text.
The inspected generic wrapper and enum implementations are native library protocol; no source-supported first-party boilerplate change is established.
ClothingError, nested GeometryError, EncodingError, io::Error and presentation string serve different roles; no type equivalence follows from display text.
